VALUATION_METHODS._AdditionalDescription:
Statement of Finished Square Footage: The subject improvements were measured according to ANSI Z765-2021 standards. The improvements were measured using a Disto laser measuring device (accurate to 1/16th of an inch) set to "decimal mode". The sketch software does not show measurements of 0 tenths of a foot. For example, 24 feet exactly, with no tenth of a foot, is shown on the sketch as 24' and not as 24.0'. Decimals are only shown if the wall measured to a tenth of a foot. For example, a wall that measured 24 feet and 5 tenths of a foot would be shown as 24.5".
Detailed calculations are located on the sketch pages of this report. Each area of the sketch is labeled along with the square feet of the area. Furthermore, the sketch pages list each section of Gross Living Area, for exmaple, First Floor, Second Floor, etc, and the total calculation of GLA. Note that GLA is referred to as "Living Area" on the sketch pages.
Any below grade (basement) square feet, if any exist, are broken out as "Finished Basement" and "Unfinished Basement" along with the total of such square feet and the calculation details. Furthermore, the amount of total basement sf and any finished basement sf, if applicable, are also listed on page 2 of the report in the sales comparison analysis.
Any areas above grade that were not included in GLA, for example areas of a second floor "Open to Below" to the first floor or an unfinished mechanical room, etc, were also specifically noted in the sketch along with their specific square feet and calculation details.
Finally, any other areas measured and included in the sketch that do not qualify as GLA, such as garage space, outbuildings, decks, patios, porches, etc, are also specifically noted on the sketch along with their square feet and calculation details.

SALES_COMPARISON._Comment:
Refer to the Analysis and Summary of the Sales Comparison Approach on Pages 3 & 4 for a more detailed explanation. All adjustments were rounded to the nearest $100. Based on limited data in the subject's immediate neighborhood, search parameters were expanded to acquire enough data for a statistically relevant trend analysis. Therefore, the active & closed sales listed in the 1004MC form's grid, if included as an assignment requirement, may not match the active & closed sales at the top of page 2 of this report. Please note that the 1004MC form, if included, was not relied on in any way in this appraisal report.
Selection of Comparable Sales: In general, homes with design/styles compatible with the subject's were preferred. Additionally, homes within 10 years (or less) of the subject's age, with GLA's within 300 sf (or less) of the subject's GLA, that had similar site sizes and locations, and that were located in the same neighborhood were preferred. Refer to the top of page 2 for the total number of similar sales within the past 12 months.
Data sources relied upon for research included the Indiana Regional MLS and the subject and comparable sale's county assessor's records and other market participants (agents, buyers, sellers, builder). The appraiser selected the best comps from the neighborhood, based on similar and relevant characteristics. While sales other than those used in the sales comparison approach exist, they were eliminated due to their less relevant characteristics or information discovered by the appraiser during the due diligence process.
See the CMA Addendum for the specific search criteria used (included at the top of page 1 of the addendum) and the results of that search criteria, included all sales and any pending or active listings, if available.
The comparables used were the most similar available in style, size, quality, condition, and market appeal. The comparables were located in the same neighborhood. Any discernible market reaction for comps that cross major highways and any effect on marketability or market value was addressed in site adjustments, if applicable. The comparables used were considered the best available, and a reliable indication of value.
See the Analysis and Summary of the Sales Comparison Approach on page 4 for a more detailed explanation on specific adjustments made.
